judge.rationale: The candidate satisfies all acceptance criteria: it removes the `instanceof Error` gate in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, wraps non-`Error` values in an `Error` with `{cause: error}`, rethrows the original value, and updates both `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` (along with test line references across specs). One potential correctness/cleanliness issue is that `String(error)` in `new Error(String(error), ...)` will throw a `TypeError` if `error` is an object with a null prototype (`Object.create(null)`) or a `Symbol`, whereas the reference tries `JSON.stringify` first; additionally, the candidate leaves behind `.lore/dod.md` and an extra acceptance test file instead of keeping all tests in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
